timeline.summary: Virtuoso Optoelectronics held Q1FY27 post-earnings conference call on August 17, 2026, reporting 85% YoY revenue growth to ₹376.6 Cr and maintaining FY27 guidance of 35-40% revenue growth with 9-10% EBITDA margin.
Virtuoso Optoelectronics allotted 16,89,859 equity shares at ₹503 each to three non-promoter investors, raising ₹85.00 Cr and lifting paid-up capital to 3,59,40,930 shares.
